run_curate_nuscenes_train: run the script to curate nuScenes training data by projecting LiDAR pointclouds to camera images and saving depth samples
create_depth_map_from_pointcloud: create a depth map from projected LiDAR points by mapping 3D coordinates to 2D image pixels
map_pointcloud_to_image: map a LiDAR pointcloud to a camera image plane using sensor calibration and intrinsic matrices
process_nuscenes_sample: process a single nuScenes sample to extract camera images, intrinsics, and sampled pixel depth values
process_multiple_nuscenes_samples: process multiple nuScenes samples across all cameras and export image paths with depth data to a JSONL file
